about:
Selhorst Woodworks operates from Las Vegas, Nevada, where husband-and-wife team Matthew and Chantel Selhorst founded the company on a shared vision to create exceptional spaces through thoughtful design and expert craftsmanship. The business identifies as family-owned and grew from a passion for woodworking into a custom finish carpentry operation serving the Las Vegas area.

The shop produces custom architectural woodwork including accent walls and ceilings, barn doors, shelving, built-ins, mudrooms, beams, baseboards, and crown molding. It also offers wallpaper installation and design services, and works with specialty materials such as Thermory thermally modified wood and Renson products. The company describes its approach as delivering meticulous attention to detail from consultation through final installation.

Clients include homeowners, interior designers, builders, and architects who value timeless design and craftsmanship. Projects range from residential upgrades to custom millwork for new construction, with the team emphasizing seamless integration of custom features into existing or new spaces.

The founders state that the company was built on an unwavering commitment to quality and the belief that the smallest details make the biggest impact. They position the business around a family-first philosophy, treating each project with the same care they would apply to their own home, and aim to create spaces that are both beautifully designed and built to be enjoyed for years.
